outside_service_window: Outside the {hours}h service window since the contact's last message: send an approved template.
opt_out: This contact asked not to receive messages.
unsupported_type: The active provider does not support {type} messages.
session_not_supported: The active provider does not use QR pairing.
media_source: Provide exactly one media source: mediaUrl or a file.
media_not_found: Media is not available from the provider.
session_NOT_CREATED: The WhatsApp instance has not been created or initialized.
session_DISCONNECTED: WhatsApp session is disconnected. Device pairing is required.
session_CONNECTING: WhatsApp session is waiting for QR code scan for authentication.
connection_exists: This provider already has a connection. Edit the existing one.
connection_phone_in_use: This number already belongs to the {provider} connection. Archive it to free the number.
connection_phone_archived: This number belongs to the archived {provider} connection. Restore the connection to keep using this number and preserve history.
connection_archived: This connection was archived and no longer sends messages.
connection_phone_mismatch: These credentials reach a different number. The connection belongs to {phone} and can only use that one.
connection_provider_immutable: A connection's provider cannot be changed.
session_PHONE_MISMATCH: The scanned QR is from a different number and the session was undone. This connection belongs to {phone}: reconnect with it.
session_PHONE_IN_USE: The scanned number already belongs to another connection and the session was undone.
session_PHONE_ARCHIVED: The scanned number belongs to an archived connection and the session was undone. Restore the corresponding connection to reuse this number.
webhook_key_missing: The webhook access key is not configured, preventing event processing.
send_timeout: The provider did not answer in time. The message may have been delivered: check before sending it again.
contact_exists: This phone number is already a contact.
template_not_approved: This template is not approved on this connection (status: {status}).
conversation_busy: A previous message to this contact is still being sent. Wait a moment and send again.
